name: tempest_rush_field_tick_seconds

name: dashing_strike_barrage_tick_seconds

name: lashing_tail_kick_column_yards

name: lashing_tail_kick_column_width_yards
notes: Lashing Tail Kick - Spinning Flame Kick: how wide the column of fire is, the strip in which an enemy is struck. name: lashing_tail_kick_dot_tick_seconds
notes: Lashing Tail Kick - Vulture Claw Kick: the interval between the ticks of the burn (230% over 3 seconds: Power/Monk_LashingTailKick.pow SF_26 scalar 2.3, SF_27 duration 3).
